definitions.definition: A mapping between two structures that shows they are essentially the same in form or function.
definitions.example: A map of a subway system is isomorphic to the actual tracks because the connections match up even though the map is smaller.

definitions.definition: Standard, accepted, or following the most common form.
definitions.example: The canonical way to solve a math problem is the method everyone agrees is correct.

definitions.definition: Sending someone or something to a different location or page.
definitions.example: When you type a wrong web address, the site might redirect you to the correct page.
